channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Cody Zeller | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Cody Zeller from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: James Borrego on Cody Zeller
item.description:
Hornets coachJames Borrego on Cody Zeller being out tonight:

“I hope to get him back against Sacramento (Sunday)...I don't see this as a lingering thing.”

James Borrego on Cody Zeller, Feb 26, 2021. Source: Twitter @rick_bonnell.

item.title: James Borrego on Cody Zeller
item.description:
Rod Boone:James Borrego on Cody Zeller:

“He's day-to-day right now. He's progressing the right way, just not enough to go tonight. So hopefully by Sunday (in Miami)., we'll have him back. That's not a guarantee, but I think he's making progress over the last few days.”

James Borrego on Cody Zeller, Mar 15, 2019. Source: Twitter @rodboone.

Hassan Whiteside on Cody Zeller, Oct 31, 2016. Source: Miami Herald.

item.title: Rich Cho on Cody Zeller
item.description:
Charlotte Hornets General Manager Rich Cho announced today that the team has exercised its fourth-year option on forward Cody Zeller.

“We are excited to keep Cody Zeller as a part of our core for another season,”

Rich Cho on Cody Zeller, Nov 2, 2015. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Steve Clifford on Cody Zeller
item.description:
Steve Clifford:

“Cody Zeller has a lot of physical ability, his basketball IQ is through the roof, he has great intangibles and he’s young. I don’t want to limit him in any way but I want him to progress at his own rate. I don’t want to put demands on him, because he’s so team-oriented he’d feel undue pressure. I’m going to watch him, let him be comfortable and see how he goes. For us to be good, he’s got to be a really big part of it. But he’s a young guy and I don’t think he needs undue demands.”

Steve Clifford on Cody Zeller, Sep 20, 2013. Source: Raleigh News & Observer.

item.title: Terry Porter on Cody Zeller
item.description:
MinnesotaTimberwolves assistant coach Terry Porter:

“(Charlotte Bobcats power forward Cody) Zeller stood out to me today in the game I watched. He played really well, showed a lot of skill, especially with his ability to run the floor.”

Terry Porter on Cody Zeller, Jul 16, 2013. Source: Oregonian.
